settings.heading: Download my data
settings.intro: Get a copy of everything about your account in one ZIP file: a data file (JSON) that other apps can read, plus every story as a Word (.docx) file.

includes.library: Your library shelves, with each story’s title and link (also as a spreadsheet, library.csv)
includes.account: Your account: username, pen name, year of birth, email address and the age check
includes.settings: Your settings, consents and the reports you made

settings.everythingNote: Everything above is in the data file. Your stories are also there as Word files, so you can open them, edit them or send them on.
settings.requestHint: We’ll tell you when it’s ready. By law we have up to one month.
settings.preparing: We’re preparing your file on this device. You can keep using the app, but keep this tab open until it’s ready. We’ll send you a notification when it’s ready.
settings.readyBody: The link works only while you’re logged in and stops working on {{date}}.
settings.downloadFailed: We couldn’t open your file. Log in again and try once more.
settings.failed: We couldn’t make your file. Please try again in a minute.
settings.loadFailed: We couldn’t check your copies. Reload the page to try again.
settings.minorsNote: You can download your own data and stories from 13. If a parent or guardian asks us for a child’s data, we check them against the consent record first.

stories.heading: Download my stories
stories.intro: Get your stories as Word (.docx) files you can edit, print or send to an agent: every chapter, drafts too, with the dates. You can add each story’s plan from Story Atlas and a machine-readable copy.
stories.hint: We’ll tell you when they’re ready. The link works only while you’re logged in and stops working after seven days. One file comes as it is; more come in one ZIP. PDF comes later.
stories.none: You haven’t started a story yet. Once you have, you can download it here as a Word file.
stories.preparing: We’re making your files on this device. You can keep using the app, but keep this tab open until they’re ready. We’ll send you a notification when they are.
stories.reused: Nothing has changed since you made these a little while ago, so here they are again.
stories.failed: We couldn’t make your files. Please try again in a minute.
stories.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your stories. Reload the page to try again.

include.chapters: The chapters, as a Word file
include.chaptersHint: Every chapter in order, drafts too, with the dates. For one story you can choose which chapters.
include.plan: The plan from Story Atlas, as a Word file
include.planHint: At a glance, characters, connections, story bible, storyline, chapter plans, ideas and marketing.
include.dataHint: The same stories and plans as data a computer program can read, for example to move them to another service.

chapters.none: This story has no chapters yet.
chapters.loadFailed: We couldn’t load the chapters. Reload the page to try again.

problems.nothingChosen: Tick at least one thing to include.
problems.noChapters: Choose at least one chapter, or pick All chapters.

holds.chapters: the chapters as a Word file
holds.chosenChapters_one: {{count}} chosen chapter as a Word file
holds.chosenChapters_few: {{count}} chosen chapters as a Word file
holds.chosenChapters_other: {{count}} chosen chapters as a Word file
holds.plan: the plan as a Word file

plan.title: The plan of {{title}}
plan.empty: Nothing planned in Story Atlas yet.

word.embedMissing: A music or video card that is no longer available

epub.heading: An EPUB for e-readers
epub.intro: This story is completed, so you can make it into an EPUB book for Kindle or any other e-reader: the cover, a copyright page, the contents, then every published chapter. The plan from Story Atlas isn’t included.
epub.dialogIntro: Check what the book will print. These details stay on this device: we don’t save them.
epub.nameHint: Your pen name, or any name you want printed as the author, your own name included. We don’t keep it, so type it each time.
epub.coverFileHint: JPEG or PNG. It goes into the book only: we don’t upload it.
epub.making: Making your EPUB on this device…
epub.saved: Your EPUB is saved as {{fileName}}. Open it in your e-reader’s app, or send it to your Kindle.
epub.failed: We couldn’t make the EPUB. Please try again.

problems.noName: Type the name to print on the book.
problems.noFile: Choose a picture, or pick the story’s cover.

copyright.noCopying: No part of this book may be copied, shared or published again in any form without written permission from {{author}}.
copyright.ownership: Every right to this work belongs to {{author}}. {{productName}} prepared this file and holds no rights to the work.
copyright.prepared: This edition was prepared through {{productName}} ({{siteUrl}}) on {{date}}.

book.embedMissing: A music or video card that is no longer available
